children: AI startup FinChip has completed a merger with AI task-dispatch platform AgentOn, the companies said on Tuesday, with the merged entity set to operate under the brand name Finch.

The merger combines FinChip's AI skills platform with AgentOn's network for matching AI agents with jobs, creating a single platform where companies can hire agents, developers can sell skills and payments can be settled, the companies said.
The platform has more than 13,000 agents and 18,600 skills, with more than 100 industry experts contributing expertise, they added.
The combined platform features four marketplaces covering AI agents, skills, human expertise and tasks.
Alongside the merger, Finch closed a pre-Series A funding round at a valuation of $50 million, with backing from investors including Waterdrip Capital and Peer VC.
Finch said it will use the proceeds to expand its supply of AI agents and skills, grow enterprise clients and promote adoption of its proposed AI skill standard.
